info.title: SquadCo Hackademy Backend API
info.description: This is the backend API for the SquadCo Hackademy project.

post.description: Creates a new user account with the provided information

message.example: Please provide a valid email address
A user with this email already exists

post.description: Verifies the OTP code sent to the user's email address

message.example: The OTP code is invalid or has expired
No user found with the provided email address

429.description: Too many requests - Rate limit exceeded

message.example: Too many OTP verification attempts. Please try again later

post.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returns user data and JWT tokens

example: password must be at least 6 characters

403.description: Forbidden - Account not verified or suspended

message.example: Account not verified. Please verify your email address

429.description: Too many requests - Rate limit exceeded

message.example: Too many login attempts. Please try again later

get.description: Retrieve information about the authenticated user

post.summary: Create a lesson in a course

get.description: Get statistics for mentees, mentors, tasks, and diary entries. Only accessible by admin users.

put.description: Change a user's role. Only accessible by admin users.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of the user to update

400.description: Bad request - Invalid role or missing user ID

patch.description: Soft delete a user account. The user can be restored later. Only accessible by admin users.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of the user to deactivate

delete.description: Permanently delete a user account. This action cannot be undone. Only accessible by admin users.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: ID of the user to delete permanently

get.description: Get all diary entries with optional user filtering. Only accessible by admin users.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Filter diary entries by user ID (optional)

get.description: Get a specific diary entry by ID with user information. Only accessible by admin users.

parameters.name: diaryId
parameters.description: ID of the diary entry to retrieve

delete.description: Permanently delete a diary entry. Only accessible by admin users.

parameters.name: diaryId
parameters.description: ID of the diary entry to delete

get.description: Retrieve leaderboard rankings for mentees with various filters
Retrieve the authenticated user's position in the leaderboard

previousRank.description: Previous rank for comparison (null if no previous data)

rankChange.description: Rank change from previous period (positive = improvement, negative = decline)
